plans.idea: Optically centered left-aligned stack: badge, headline+sub and CTA grouped tightly in the middle of the tall canvas on one shared left edge, with equal calm whitespace above and below instead of a dead gap splitting copy from the button.

Top-to-bottom story poster: NEW tag and an oversized headline fill the upper half as the dominant focal point, CTA anchors the bottom on the same left edge, so the eye drops headline then sub then action.

Bottom-weighted layout faithful to the original pairing: open dark field on top for mood, headline+sub in the lower half, and the CTA with the NEW badge beside it as one action row, exactly as in the source banner.
